description: Ability to safely isolate electrical circuits and follow lockout-tagout procedures before working on equipment.
Skill in wiring and assembling a single-phase distribution board including MCBs, RCCBs, and bus bars.
Knowledge and ability to perform earthing installations and continuity testing of circuits.
Ability to read, interpret, and work from electrical circuit diagrams and schematics.
Systematic approach to diagnosing and fixing faults in switchboards and panels.

item: Use of multimeter and clamp meter
description: Proficiency in using multimeters and clamp meters for voltage, current, resistance, and continuity measurements.
Understanding and adherence to IS 732, IE rules, and National Electrical Code safety standards.
